name: k7-states
about: A LumaScript state machine (language 11.2) per object of a mod's class (Stepper replaces Kuribo), run from the control override the back end adds: Count's update counts to 20 and goes to Wait (its exit sees 20); Wait's task waits 10 frames while its update counts on, then goes to Done, whose enter reads is_state and stops the machine
